items.title: Bitcoin Has No Value
items.quote: Cryptocurrencies basically have no value and they don't produce anything. They don't reproduce, they can't mail you a check, they can't do anything, and what you hope is that somebody else comes along and pays you more money for them later on, but then that person's got the problem. In terms of value: zero.

items.title: R.I.P. Bitcoin. It’s Time To Move On.
items.quote: Let’s also bear in mind what it is that makes some venture capitalists Bitcoin zealots: pure greed. That is the reason clearest to me for Bitcoin’s failure. Intended as a level playing field and a more efficient transaction system, the Bitcoin system has deteriorated into a fight between interested parties over a pool of money. In the beginning, Bitcoin was a noble experiment. Now, it is a distraction. It’s time to build more rational, transparent, robust, accountable systems of governance to pave the way to a more prosperous future for everyone.

陈天禅被认为是当代最具创新精神与思想深度的跨媒介艺术家之一。他的艺术实践融合了严谨的数学和编程技术与富有创新的视觉艺术风格，打破了传统艺术与现代科技之间的界限。他的作品集合了各种媒介，混合了数学美学、编程视觉与互动装置，模糊了纯艺术与科技艺术的边界。从机器学习算法驱动的动态画作到基于编程逻辑的互动装置，他的作品在实验性和理性之美之间构建了独特的桥梁。这些作品不仅在视觉艺术领域中展现了他的才华，同时也在科技艺术界引起了广泛关注，为观众创造了一个既现实又幻想的艺术体验空间。

陈天禅出生于中国江苏南京，而后在北京这座充满活力且处于全球化前沿的大都市成长。在这样的环境中，他的艺术视野被深刻地塑造，受到了多元文化和科技发展的影响。他的作品深受其对数学原理和宇宙宏观之美的关注所启发，经常探索事物的本质以及基于数学和物理学定律的浪漫猜想。他的艺术创作不仅仅是对外部世界的反映，更是对内在思考的展现。作为一位数学专业毕业的艺术家，他在作品中巧妙地融合了理性的思维和感性的表达。这种独特的结合使得他的艺术作品既具有深刻的哲学思考，又不失诗意的美感。陈天禅的作品在呈现东西方哲学思想、文化和认知方式时，展现了他宽广的视角。在这些作品中，我们可以看到一种独特的探索精神：从寻求数学之美的抽象概念到探讨宇宙与人类存在的深层次联系。他的艺术作品不断地向观众提出问题，引发深思，同时也提供了一种新颖而独到的审美体验。

陈天禅毕业于麻省理工学院苏世民计算机学院的机器学习项目，在阿尔弗雷德大学电子艺术系，纽约大学数学系和伍伦贡大学数学系的学术经历，深化了他对艺术与数学结合的探索。2023年8月，他作为策展人成功主持了北京798艺术区的《无人之境》人工智能艺术展，并因此被雅昌艺术网评为当月最具影响力策展人之一。同年，他的人工智能艺术作品《先知》和《无限极》分别荣登全球最具影响力人工智能艺术品榜单的第一位和第九位。此外，他的人工智能水印木刻版画《未来前史：物质于意识》在浙江美术馆举办的亚运专题展览《博弈论》中展出，受到社会和学术界的一致好评。2024年1月11日，作品《八荒》成功进入地球轨道，成为人类首件登陆太空的人工智能艺术。

陈天禅目前生活工作于美国纽约。

王屿星，1985年出生于中国重庆，2007年毕业于四川美术学院，现生活工作于北京。他关注自然现象，自我意识，人与环境的关系，以及图像生产对于个人或集体审美的塑造与精神世界的影响，他相信视觉语言的力量，倾向于以图像作为媒介，对人的内心世界与外部世界的联结进行“有意识”与“无意识”的创作，通过基于想象预设再造，与观察捕捉截取，来获得新的灵感。他的作品曾在三影堂摄影艺术中心，798艺术中心，上海展览中心等机构展出。作品《木未成舟》入围2014年第六届三影堂摄影奖。他的作品与访谈曾刊登于美国艺术摄影杂志《Musée Magazine》，《V Magazine China》中文版，《中国摄影家》，《数码摄影》，HAKUCHI，等。

Wang Yuxing，From China，born in Chongqing, was graduated from Sichuan Fine Arts Institute. At present, he lives in Beijing. As an artist who advocates the power of visual language, Wang is inclined to display the connections between people’s inner world and the outside world through images in a “conscious” or “unconscious” way. He is inspired by imagination, prediction and reconstruction, as well as observation, capture, and interception.  His works have been exhibited at “Three Shadows Photography Art Center”,798 Art Center , “Shanghai Exhibition Center”and other institutions. His works “The night is burning” was selected for the 6th Three Shadows Photography Award in 2014. His work and interviews have been published in the American Journal of Art Photography“Musée Magazine”,“V Magazine China”，“Chinese Photographers”，“FOTO VIDEO”，“HAKUCHI”, etc.

creator.description:
张增增，男，2013年毕业于四川美术学院雕塑系获硕士学位，多年致力于科技手段与城市三维空间之结合，试图将不可见的哲学和社会逻辑可视化、三维化。努力使得作品尺寸超越小物体，造境取代消极造物，从图像而至现象，由场所到城市，从小范围的有限个人感知抵达无边无尽的空间。在过去十余年中进行了一系列美术馆内外的研究，有关新的材料学，空间技术和城市现象。从城市、景观、室内、公共关系各角度展开的跨学科研究。现任教于四川美术学院雕塑系跨媒介工作室。
Zhang Zengzeng, male, graduated from the Sculpture Department of Sichuan Fine Arts Institute in 2013 with a master's degree. For many years, he has devoted himself to the combination of scientific and technological means and urban three-dimensional space, trying to visualize and three-dimensional invisible philosophy and social logic.
Strive to make the size of the work beyond small objects, create environment instead of negative creation, from images to phenomena, from places to cities, from limited personal perception on a small scale to endless space.
Over the past ten years, a series of research has been carried out both inside and outside the museum, concerning new materials science, space technology and urban phenomena.
Interdisciplinary research from the perspectives of city, landscape, interior and public relations.
He is currently teaching at the cross-media Studio of Sculpture Department, Sichuan Fine Arts Institute.

Zhang Xiao

He won the Three Shadows Photography Award in 2010 with They series. He also received the second Hou Dengke Documentary Photography Award in 2009, The Photography Talent Award (France) in 2010 and the Prix HSBC pour la Photographie in 2011 with his Coastline series. Zhang has participated in several solo and group exhibitions, including “Shehuo”, Harvard University Peabody Museum of Archaeology and Ethnology,  “ The World in 2015 ”, “Civilization: The Way We Live Now”( Ullens Centre for Contemporary Art, Beijing, China),    “ Unfamiliar Familiarities ” , ( Fotostiftung Schweiz ,Winterthur, Switzerland), “ Photoquai ”， ( Quai Branly Museum，Paris，France ),  and “ Apple ”, ( Lianzhou Photography Museum, Guangdong, China), “ Social Geography: Ten Journeys with a Camera , (Shanghai Centre of Photography ,Shanghai , China) , “ Photography and Video Experiments in Southwestern China since 2000 ” , (A4 Art Museum ,Chengdu , China) , “The Farm”, (chi k11 Art Space, Shenyang, China), etc. Zhang currently lives and works in Chengdu city, Sichuan province, China.

creator.description: 雎安奇是目前备受国际瞩目的中国电影导演、艺术家之一。作品参加过超过40个国际影展，也曾于巴黎蓬皮杜中心、纽约现代艺术博物馆、纽约古根海姆美术馆等国际顶级艺术机构展出。电影处女作《北京的风很大》入围50届柏林国际电影节，2015年剧情片《诗人出差了》在第44届鹿特丹国际电影节首映并获得了最佳亚洲电影大奖，以及第16届韩国全州国际电影节最高大奖。最新剧情长片《海面上漂过的奖杯》在第3届平遥国际电影展获得三项大奖。2019年开始拍摄全球首部中国建筑遗产纪录片“中国建筑遗产三部曲”，2022年完成三部曲首部影片《楼》，入围第四届海南国际电影展，2022年度中国纪录片学院奖提名，第25届上海国际电影节，2023年第45届联合国教科文组织探索之星奖。2023年雎安奇担任了第25届上海国际电影节金爵奖评委。雎安奇亦是中国单色绘画的代表，其创作的《草体》绘画系列作品在亚洲的单色画创作领域中享有重要地位，作品呈现在全球众多的重量级展览，美术馆和艺术博览会上。

Zhenchen Liu, lives and works between Paris and Shanghai. 现为中央美术学院实验艺术学院教授、硕士研究生导师，文化部恭王府中华传统技艺研究与保护中心研究员，北京动物园学术委员会委员。

近年来，邬建安的作品先后参加《越后妻有大地艺术三年展》（日本新泻越后妻有，2018）、第57届威尼斯双年展中国馆《不息》（意大利威尼斯，2017）、《蛇形》（日本东京森美术馆；新加坡艺术科学博物馆，2017）、《亚洲艺术部成立百年猴年新春特别项目》（美国纽约大都会艺术博物馆，2016）、《三十年的中国当代艺术：卡罗琳与雷内收藏展》（美国波士顿美术博物馆，2015）、《多重宇宙：民生二十一世纪美术馆开馆展》（上海民生二十一世纪美术馆，2014）、《大道之行：中国当代公共艺术展》（德国卡塞尔，2012）、《山水意园：中国当代艺术展》（美国华盛顿肯尼迪艺术中心，2011）、《共再生——第四届福冈亚洲三年展》（日本福冈亚洲美术馆，2009），并在北京、上海、香港、纽约等地举办多次个人艺术展。

美国波士顿美术博物馆、美国洛杉矶艺术博物馆、美国康奈尔大学赫伯特 F. 约翰逊艺术博物馆、巴西奥斯卡·尼迈耶博物馆、中央美术学院美术馆、北京民生现代美术馆、香港亚洲艺术文献库、澳大利亚白兔艺术基金会等机构和个人收藏有邬建安的作品。

他获得的主要艺术奖项包括“2017年度青年力量”（《南方人物周刊》）、“2018年度40 Under 40亚洲卓越艺术家”（Perspective《视野》杂志）、“第11届中国艺术权力榜 ——Art Power 100”、“第8届全球华人金星奖——年度中坚力量”（《国家美术》）等。



Wu Jian’an was born in Beijing in 1980.

He received his Bachelor of Arts degree from Beijing Broadcasting Institute in 2002. In 2005, he earned a masters degree in Fine Art at Central Academy of Fine Arts (CAFA), then joint the faculty of CAFA.

He currently lives and works in Beijing, as professor and master instructor of School of Experimental Art at CAFA，research of Chinese Arts and Crafts Institute of Prince Kung’ s Palace Museum, member of the Academic Committee of Beijing Zoo.

In recent years, his works have attended Live and Let Live: Creators of Tomorrow—The 4th Fukuoka Asian Art Triennial (Fukuoka Asian Art Museum, Fukuoka, Japan, 2009), Mind in Landscape (The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts, Washington DC, USA, 2011), ALLES UNTER DEM HIMMEL GEHORT ALLEN: Chinese Public Art in Kassel (Kassel, Germany, 2012), Cosmos (Shanghai 21st Century Minsheng Art Museum, Shanghai, China, 2014), The Carolyn Hsu and René Balcer Collection: Exploring Three Decades of Contemporary Chinese Art (Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, USA, 2015), Lunar New Year: The Year of the Monkey (Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York City, USA, 2016), Continuum: Generation by Generation (The 57th Venice Biennale China Pavilion, Virgin Garden, Venice, Italy, 2017), Serpenti Form (Art Science Museum, Singapore, Singapore; Mori Art Gallery, Tokyo, Japan, 2017), Echigo-Tsumari Art Triennial 2018 (Echigo-Tsumari, Japan, 2018), etc. He has held several solo exhibitions in Beijing, Shanghai, Hong Kong and New York City.

Wu Jian’an’s works are in the collection of Museum of Fine Arts, Boston, Los Angeles County Museum Of Art, Herbert F. Johnson Museum of Art, Cornell University, Oscar Niemeyer Museum, Central Academy of Fine Arts Museum, Beijing Minsheng Art Museum and Asia Art Archives, etc.

creator.description: 司马源 SIMA Yuan, artist and curator with dual educational background in science and art, 10-year piano player, co-founder of Waterhead Radio. Born in Beijing, she obtained a B.S. from Nanjing University and a M.A. from London College of Communication, University of the Arts London. Her works have been known at Sound Art Museum, TELESCOPE, AMNUA, School for Curatorial Studies Venice (Italy), FORMAT15 International Photography Festival (UK), KABUSO Art Museum (Norway), Central Saint Martins College of Art and Design (UK), etc., involving various media and forms such as soundscape, experimental theater, video, painting, literature, performance art and virtual design, etc. She has curated sound exhibitions at Beijing Minsheng Art Museum, MOCUBE and CHAO. Last year, she won the first prize in “To the Moon Virtual Image Design Tourn” at BEIJING DESIGN WEEK 2023.

creator.description:
明天见是滕斐、黄扬、梁荣三人组成的艺术组合，他们各自从事于当代艺术、音乐策划、平面设计、摄影影像、视觉艺术等领域，以多元跨文化的视角不断观察艺术与当下社会及生活周边的相互关系和影响，再创作出对应的作品。明天见近期参与的艺术项目：“打开的窗户”，OCT-LOFT公共艺术展，华侨城创意文化园，2021年；“艺术生成艺术”，ONE ART湾汇艺术季，深圳湾一号南广场，2022年；第十届“艺术深圳”户外公共艺术项目，深圳会展中心，2023年。
seeyoutomorrow is an art group formed by Teng Fei, Huang Yang, and Liang Rong. They have individually engaged in contemporary art, music curation, graphic design, photography and videography, and visual art. From a diverse, cross-cultural perspective, the group has observed the interrelation and interaction between art and social reality and life, contributing works in response to the observations. Recently, seeyoutomorrow has participated in the following art projects: The Open Windows, OCT-LOFT Public Art Exhibition, OCT-Loft, 2021; Art Becoming Art, ONE ART, South Square, One Shenzhen Bay, 2022; Outdoor Public Art Program, The 10th Art Shenzhen, Shenzhen Convention and Exhibition Center, 2023.

creator.description:
陈霄，1984年生于上海，“In Situ（在现场）”工作方式艺术家，目前生活工作于上海。先后毕业于上海大学美术学院雕塑系、法国斯特拉斯堡国立高等装饰艺术学院艺术系“Hors-Format”工作室，并获得硕士学位。作品主要以日常生活、个人经验为线索进行创作，同时对时间与物理空间的关系进行讨论。作品多以影像、装置与行为构建一个现场，显现一种游走于“边界”上的个体经验。

CHEN Xiao, (b.1984), an ‘ In Situ ’ artist, currently lives and works in Shanghai. The artist got his bachelor degree in Fine Art College of Shanghai University in Sculpture and got his master degree in Ecole supérieure des arts decoratifs de Strasbourg. The artist’s work based on daily life, personal experience and also discuss about time and physical space. The artist constructs a situation with video, installation and performance to express a personal experience of rambling by the ‘ Limit ’.

曾就职于腾讯总部，担任国际业务部Global SNS首席产品设计师。2016年考入中央美术学院攻读硕士学位，读研期间专注于使用区块链底层技术进行艺术转化，并不断探索独特的艺术语言。2017年开始创办区块链企业，作为创始人身份参与了ProChain、YFII与TopBidder三个项目，2019年因业务繁忙休学一年，2020年获中央美术学院硕士学位。

作品收藏:
《红与蓝》被韩国蔚山美术馆收藏

Mrs Jiaying Liu (CryptoZR) has experience working at Tencent headquarters as the Chief Designer of Global SNS at International Business Department.
In 2016, she enrolled in China Central Academy of Fine art(CAFA) to pursue her master degree. During her studies, she focused on using underlying blockchain technology to explore artistic transformation and kept developing unique artistic languages.

Since 2017, she founded blockchain enterprises ProChain, TopBidder and YFII.
In 2019, she took a gap year away from school due to the business and in 2020 received a master of fine arts degree from China Central Academy of Fine Arts.

In the year 2021, CryptoZR held a solo CryptoArt exhibition at Guardian Art Center in Beijing titled: COOKIE COOKIE, the first ever exhibition of it’s kind.
